title: Teachable & Thinkific Alternative India: UPI, ₹ Plans (2026)
description: An Indian alternative to Teachable and Thinkific, compared fairly: US-dollar plans next to rupee platforms with UPI checkout, own app and domain, and when to stay put.
og_description: Teachable, Thinkific, Learnyst, Edmingle, Graphy and AllCoaching compared for Indian educators, with every price from the official site (checked 24 Oct 2026) and a clear answer on when a US platform still fits.
h1: Indian Alternative to Teachable and Thinkific (2026): UPI Checkout, Rupee Plans, Prices Checked
dek: A fair comparison for Indian educators who started on Teachable or Thinkific, or are about to: what each US platform charges in dollars, which Indian platforms price in rupees with UPI checkout, and when staying put is the better call.
cover_alt: Teachable or Thinkific alternative in India: Teachable, Thinkific, Learnyst, Edmingle, Graphy and AllCoaching compared, prices checked on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Indian educators and tutors comparing Teachable or Thinkific with Indian course platforms that price in rupees
intro: Yes, there are Indian alternatives to Teachable and Thinkific with UPI checkout and rupee pricing: AllCoaching fits an educator who wants a website on their own domain, their own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) and UPI or card checkout, set up without a sales call; Learnyst fits test-heavy exam academies; and Edmingle fits training businesses. If most of your buyers are outside India and pay by card in dollars, staying on Teachable or Thinkific can still be the better choice.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every competitor price below comes from that company's own pricing page, with the link and the date we checked it, and we say plainly where another option fits better than ours.

Both US platforms publish their prices in US dollars. Teachable starts at US$39 a month (US$29 a month billed annually) with a 7.5% transaction fee on its Starter plan. Thinkific starts at US$109 a month (US$82 a month billed annually). For an Indian educator, Indian GST and your bank's foreign-currency charges may be added on top.
takeaways: Teachable lists Starter at US$39 a month (US$29 billed annually) with a 7.5% transaction fee, Builder at US$89 and Growth at US$189 a month with 0% transaction fees, and a 7-day free trial (checked 24 Oct 2026).
Thinkific lists Start at US$109, Grow at US$219 and Expand at US$499 a month (US$82, US$164 and US$374 billed annually), a 30-day free trial, and a branded mobile app as a US$199 a month add-on.
Both price in US dollars; Indian GST and foreign-currency card charges may apply, and neither pricing page lists UPI, so ask before you rely on it.

AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales (Starter), with Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5% and Scale ₹99,999 + 0%; GST extra, 7-day free trial with no card, UPI and card checkout with automatic Razorpay payouts.

On published rupee prices, AllCoaching costs less than Learnyst up to about ₹14.4 lakh of sales a year and less than Edmingle Core up to about ₹13 lakh; above those levels their flat plans cost less on paper.
Your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) and your own domain are included on every AllCoaching plan.
If you also sell abroad, run both: keep the US platform for dollar buyers and an Indian academy for rupee and UPI buyers.

sections.h2: The short answer: pick by where your students pay
sections.html:
The right Teachable or Thinkific alternative depends mostly on one question: where are your students, and how do they pay? Start from that.

{{fig:verdict|Which Teachable or Thinkific alternative to choose in India: own website and app with UPI checkout, AllCoaching; test-series academy, Learnyst; training business with branches, Edmingle; buyers mostly abroad, stay on Teachable or Thinkific|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide explains each choice.}}

If you are not sure yet, the next sections show how we compared the options and why Indian educators usually start looking.

sections.h2: How we compared Teachable, Thinkific and Indian alternatives
sections.html:
We compared the two US platforms with four options Indian educators often shortlist: AllCoaching, Learnyst, Edmingle and Graphy. We looked at six things that change what you pay, what your students can do at checkout, and what you own.

  1. Published price and currency, taken only from each company's own pricing page.
  2. Fee on your sales, including transaction fees on entry plans.
  3. Checkout for Indian students: rupee prices and UPI, or something to ask the vendor.
  4. What you own: your domain, your app listing and your student data.
  5. How you start: free trial length and whether you need a call.
  6. Limits that bite later, such as product caps or an app sold as an add-on.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why Indian educators look for a Teachable or Thinkific alternative
sections.html:
Teachable and Thinkific are mature, well-built course platforms. Indian educators rarely leave because of a missing feature. They leave because of currency, checkout and the cost of an app.

What Teachable and Thinkific do well

Teachable sells course, coaching and membership tools with global payments and tax handling, and its tagline is "Launch, sell, and scale your online business."[1] Thinkific combines courses, community and live cohorts with commerce tools, and describes itself as "Built for businesses that can't afford to outgrow their platform".[2] Both have years of product work behind them, and both let you try before paying.

1. Paying in US dollars for an Indian business

Your students pay ₹499 for a test series or ₹2,999 for a batch. Your platform bill is in dollars, so its rupee cost changes with the exchange rate, your card may add a foreign-currency charge, and Indian GST may apply. Our guide to GST and income tax for online tutors explains the tax side in plain words.

2. A checkout your students can finish

Many Indian students have no credit card, and a parent often pays from a UPI app. Neither the Teachable nor the Thinkific pricing page lists UPI as a payment method. Thinkific's FAQ says Thinkific Payments is priced "in line with other processors like Stripe and PayPal at 2.9%", and that third-party processors add a gateway fee. Ask both platforms whether your Indian students can pay by UPI and what it costs. Our guide to the best UPI payment gateway for online courses covers why this decides conversions.

{{q:Should I leave Teachable or Thinkific if some of my students are abroad?|Not necessarily. If a real share of your buyers pay by card in dollars, keep the US platform for them. Many educators run an Indian academy alongside it for rupee and UPI buyers, and decide later from the numbers.}}

3. Your own app costs extra

Thinkific sells a branded mobile app as a US$199 a month add-on, included only on select Plus plans. For Teachable, ask whether an app under your own name is available and on which plan. For educators whose students live on their phones, an app included on every plan changes the maths.

4. Product limits on lower plans

Teachable's Starter plan allows 5 products, Builder 10 and Growth 50. A coaching educator who sells separate batches, test series and notes can reach those caps quickly.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: paying a platform in US dollars, wondering whether students can pay by UPI, an app sold as an add-on, product caps and doubts on WhatsApp, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes and UPI checkout|Whatever you choose, the goal is the same: a checkout your students can finish, in the currency they use.}}

sections.h2: Teachable and Thinkific alternatives in India, compared fairly
sections.html:
Here is each option as its own company describes it, with the published price, what to check, and who it suits best. Staying on Teachable or Thinkific is included, because for some educators it is the right answer.

Our platform · disclosure

1. AllCoaching

Good at
An academy you build yourself, like Shopify for coaching: sign up, choose a plan, upload your course, connect your domain and start selling. Website on your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), courses, tests, PDF notes, unlimited live classes (YouTube Live, Zoom or the built-in room) and UPI or card checkout with automatic Razorpay payouts.
Published price
Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales, Growth ₹12,999/yr + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999/yr + 5%, Scale ₹99,999/yr + 0%; GST extra. Pricing[6]
Free trial
7 days, no card needed.
Check
The percentage on sales adds up as you grow; above about ₹13 lakh of sales a year, a flat-price plan elsewhere can cost less, and above ₹15 lakh AllCoaching's own Scale plan (₹99,999, 0% on sales) beats Pro. If you sell to buyers abroad, confirm the payment methods you need before moving them.
Best for
Indian educators who want their own brand, rupee pricing and UPI checkout, and want to set it up themselves.

2. Learnyst

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with content protection and test series; it says it gives you the "features required to market and sell your content online".
Published price
Launcher ₹10,000/yr + 10% of sales; Professional ₹8,999/month (₹8,099/month billed annually) with 0% transaction fees; higher plans up to ₹49,999/month; taxes extra.[3]
Free trial
Not stated as a trial; buttons say "Get started for free".
Check
Its page says apps are published under Learnyst's developer account, and a branded Android app starts from Premium (₹14,999/month).
Best for
Exam-prep academies where mock tests are the main product.

3. Edmingle

Good at
An LMS for professional training and skilling businesses, with batches, branches and white-labelled academies; it calls itself an "AI-powered LMS purpose-built for professional training and skilling businesses".
Published price
Core ₹7,499/month, Prime ₹14,999/month, Power ₹29,999/month, billed annually (higher if monthly); taxes extra.[4]
Free trial
7-day free start.
Check
The page does not state a fee on sales; a branded Android app starts from Prime and branded iOS from Power.
Best for
Training businesses and larger institutes that want detailed operations features.

4. Graphy

Good at
An all-in-one platform for creators and coaches: website builder, branded apps, digital products and AI sales agents, to "launch, scale, and automate your online teaching business".
Published price
Graphy publishes plans on graphy.com/pricing, but prices are shown by country and we could not confirm the Indian rupee plans on 24 Oct 2026; check the page from India.[5]
Free trial
14 days.
Check
The rupee price of each plan, the fee per sale, and which plan includes the iOS app.
Best for
Creators selling to their own YouTube or Instagram audience.

5. Stay on Teachable or Thinkific

Good at
Mature course builders with global payments; Teachable adds tax handling, Thinkific adds community and live cohorts.
Published price
Teachable: Starter US$39 (US$29 billed annually) + 7.5% transaction fee, Builder US$89 (US$69), Growth US$189 (US$139) a month with 0% transaction fees. Thinkific: Start US$109 (US$82), Grow US$219 (US$164), Expand US$499 (US$374) a month. Prices in US dollars.[1][2]
Free trial
Teachable 7 days with a 30-day guarantee; Thinkific 30 days.
Check
UPI availability for Indian buyers, processing fees, GST on your bill, and Teachable's product caps.
Best for
Educators whose buyers are mostly abroad and pay by card in dollars.

sections.h2: What each option costs as you grow
sections.html:
A yearly price only tells half the story when a platform also takes a percentage. The chart adds each published rupee plan to its published fee at six sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan at each level. Teachable and Thinkific are not on the chart because they price in US dollars, and we do not convert currencies.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at ₹50,000 to ₹15 lakh of sales from published rupee prices for AllCoaching, Learnyst and Edmingle|Before GST. Edmingle's line is its listed Core price only, because its pricing page does not state a fee on sales.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: on published rupee prices, AllCoaching costs less than Learnyst up to about ₹14.4 lakh of sales a year, and less than Edmingle Core up to about ₹13 lakh. Above those levels, their flat plans are lower on paper, provided Edmingle confirms there is no fee on sales. Remember what each price includes: AllCoaching includes your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) on every plan, while Learnyst's branded Android app starts from Premium and Edmingle's from Prime.

For the dollar platforms, compare in their own terms. Teachable Starter is US$29 a month billed annually plus 7.5% of each sale; Thinkific Start is US$82 a month billed annually, plus US$199 a month if you add its branded app. Use our plan finder to run your own rupee numbers.

sections.h2: Which Teachable or Thinkific alternative fits you
sections.html:
Exam educator with Indian students (NEET, JEE, SSC, banking, CUET)

Your students pay in rupees, mostly by UPI, and study on a phone. An academy with your own app, UPI checkout and unlimited live classes fits best. Our guide on how to sell courses online in India walks through the first sale.

Skill educator teaching in Hindi or Hinglish (spoken English, yoga, coding, music)

Courses at ₹499 to ₹2,999 need a low fixed cost and a checkout that works on any phone. See how to price online courses in India and teaching spoken English online.

Test-series academy

If most of your revenue comes from mocks, look closely at Learnyst and compare it with building tests inside your own academy. See how to create mock tests online.

Educator selling mostly abroad

Stay on Teachable or Thinkific for dollar buyers. If your Indian audience grows, add an Indian academy for rupee and UPI buyers rather than forcing both groups through one checkout. A website on your own domain keeps your brand in one place either way; see LMS with a custom domain.

sections.h2: How to move from Teachable or Thinkific without losing students
sections.html:
The safe way to switch is to run both platforms side by side. Students who already bought keep their access on the old platform; new Indian admissions go to your new academy.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to move from Teachable or Thinkific: build your academy, run both side by side, send new Indian admissions to your academy, close the old plan at renewal|Nobody loses access, and nobody pays twice.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Start the 7-day trial, connect your domain and upload one complete course with its demo lesson.
Run both platforms side by side
Keep existing students on Teachable or Thinkific so nobody loses access to what they bought.
Send new admissions to your academy
Share your own website and app link on YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp, with rupee prices and UPI checkout.
Export records and close the old plan
Download student and payment records, then downgrade or end the US plan at renewal once access periods are over.

faq: Is there an Indian alternative to Teachable and Thinkific that supports UPI?

Yes. AllCoaching includes UPI and card checkout with automatic Razorpay payouts on every plan, from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales, with a 7-day free trial and no card needed. Learnyst and Edmingle also price in rupees; ask them which payment methods your students can use.
How much do Teachable and Thinkific cost in India?

Teachable lists Starter at US$39, Builder at US$89 and Growth at US$189 a month, and Thinkific lists Start at US$109, Grow at US$219 and Expand at US$499 a month, with lower monthly prices billed annually (checked 24 Oct 2026). Prices are in US dollars, so Indian GST and foreign-currency card charges may apply.
Do Teachable and Thinkific charge a fee on sales?

Teachable charges a 7.5% transaction fee on Starter and 0% on Builder and Growth, with processing fees separate. Thinkific states no platform transaction fee on its pricing page, but payment processing fees apply.
Can Indian students pay by UPI on Teachable or Thinkific?
Neither pricing page lists UPI as a payment method (checked 24 Oct 2026). Ask each platform directly before you rely on it for Indian buyers.

We do not compare across currencies, because the rupee cost of a dollar plan changes with the exchange rate. AllCoaching Starter is ₹6,999 a year plus 10% of sales; Teachable Starter is US$29 a month billed annually plus a 7.5% transaction fee.
Can I get my own app without paying for an add-on?

Yes. Every AllCoaching plan includes your own white-label Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale). Thinkific sells a branded mobile app as a US$199 a month add-on; for Teachable, ask whether one is available on your plan.
I also sell to international students. Should I still switch?

Not necessarily. Keep Teachable or Thinkific for buyers who pay in dollars, and run an Indian academy alongside it for rupee and UPI buyers. Compare the two after a few batches and move only what the numbers support.
How do I move my courses from Teachable or Thinkific without disrupting students?

Upload your course to the new academy, keep existing students on the old platform until their access period ends, send new admissions to your own website and app, then export records and end the old plan at renewal.

Keeping the old and new platforms active at the same time during a switch, so current students keep access.
